verdict.rationale: Stable's marketing pages say it provides in-product AI document summaries of mail contents, list "AI summaries" as a plan feature, and describe an "AI-powered inbox" that auto-sorts and routes mail. That gives users AI-generated insight into their data. However, the evidence is only brief marketing claims and never shows AI-generated suggestions or recommendations. Missing for 10: AI suggestions or recommended actions, in-depth documentation of the summary feature, independent or hands-on corroboration, any insights beyond per-document summaries.
